Donald Trump’s
efforts to lower energy costs. He urged Congress to curb federal spending, reduce regulations, and balance the budget to help address inflation.
Scott Defends Trump’s Energy Policies
On Saturday, in his post on
X
, Scott acknowledged Americans’ concerns about the cost of living, writing, "Americans are worried about the high cost of living, and I don’t blame them."
He added that Trump was doing his part to address the issue but urged Congress to "DELIVER FOR FAMILIES and PROTECT THE AMERICAN DREAM."

In a Fox News interview clip shared alongside the post, Scott said Trump was working to reduce oil and gasoline prices through increased domestic energy production and cooperation with Venezuela, while acknowledging the need to defend the U.S. against Iran.
"Trump is doing everything he can… to get oil and gas prices down," Scott said.
Scott Calls For Budget Cuts To Curb Inflation
Scott argued that Congress must take responsibility for the federal budget, pointing to annual deficits of about $2 trillion.
"We’re the ones that have to balance the budget," he said, adding that balancing the budget would help bring inflation under control.
Scott also promoted his ‘Rescuing America’ plan, which calls for balancing the budget, dramatically reducing regulations and streamlining the permitting process.
"That’ll get prices down. That I did as governor of Florida," Scott said, referring to his push to reduce regulatory hurdles and speed up approvals.
